rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge Prof. Varma's concern regarding the real policy rate; however, with headline CPI at 5.02% and food inflation at 6.56% amidst a 6% monsoon deficit, the risks to the inflation trajectory remain elevated. A shift to a 'neutral' stance at this juncture would be premature and could be misconstrued as a premature easing of our commitment to price stability. While I agree with Dr. Goyal that we must not stifle the 7.60% GVA growth, the positive output gap of 0.70% suggests that the economy has sufficient momentum to withstand the current policy stance. We must remain data-dependent and ensure that inflation durably aligns with the 4.00% target before considering any change in our stance.
